snippet.title: Project Freefall 🪂 Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
What is UP, guys, and welcome back to the channel! Today, we're diving headfirst (literally) into the CHAOS that is my newest idea come to life, Project Freefall! 

OK so picture this: You and your whole crew just get YEETED out of a plane. ✈️ Only problem, there's ONE parachute. ONE. You either secure the 'chute and get the W, or you're about to test out fall damage IRL. 💀 It's a total L + ratio + you fell off moment. Literally.

We're talkin' 8-player mayhem, cross-platform play, and a whole arsenal of crazy tools and obstacles to mess with your opponents. We're talking paint grenades, fire extinguishers, and even SHARKS! 🦈

This game is pure, unadulterated fun, and I am SO here for it.

👇 Drop a comment below if you're ready to dive in, and TAG that friend is going to go SPLAT every round! GGs all around. Silas Meridian, out.

📣 Play Project Freefall for Free on:
▸  SteamVR: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592440/Project_Freefall/
▸ Meta Horizon Store: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/project-freefall/7932952873476077/
▸ Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/project-freefall-9dae94

📣 Follow Project Freefall for the Latest Updates: 
▸ Website: https://schellgames.com/freefall
